content:
I opened two small independent PRs:

#41678 refactors the proof of instance : Limits.HasBinaryBiproducts (Rep.{w} k G) into a reusable concrete categorical biproduct record.

#41616 suggests to move the one line instance Abelian (Rep.{w} k G) from Rep.Iso to Rep.Basic. This will remove the commutativity assumption on the coefficient ring k.

I want to know if these two changes are reasonable. The first is useful for me at obtaining the abelian structure on the category of smooth representations, avoiding duplicate proofs. The second has no obvious application for me, but it is cheap and mathematically natural.
